excerpt: Time is Ltd. is a Prague-based collaboration analytics platform that measures how teams spend time across email, calendars, chat and meetings.
content:
Time is Ltd. makes collaboration analytics software. It connects to the tools a company already uses, such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoom and Slack, and turns the metadata about meetings, emails, chats and focus time into dashboards for managers. Its website sells three packages around that data: an HR solution aimed at engagement and attrition, a sales solution that looks at how revenue teams spend time with clients, and an operations solution about collaboration and working patterns. The product shows, for example, how much time a department spends in meetings, how much focus time people get, and which teams collaborate across the company. In 2023 the company launched Collaboration Analytics 2.0 with more than 200 metrics and a data platform and API so customers can send the data into tools such as Google BigQuery or Tableau. Its site navigation also notes that its Org Chart product is now part of Unaric Solutions.

Time is Ltd. is based in Prague. Tech.eu reported that it was founded by Jan Rezab and Cyril Höschl; TechCrunch noted that Rezab previously founded the social media analytics company Socialbakers. In June 2021 it raised a $5.6 million late-seed round led by Mike Chalfen of Chalfen Ventures, with Illuminate Financial, Accel and Acequia Capital, and Ulf Zetterberg, founder of Seal Software, joined as president and co-founder. TechCrunch named the Czech e-grocery group Rohlik as a customer at the time. In 2022 the company added Zoom analytics.

Pricing

Time is Ltd. does not publish prices on its website. It offers a demo and quotes plans on request.

Who it suits

It fits HR, operations and sales leaders at mid-size and large companies that want data on hybrid work, meeting load and collaboration. Small teams, or companies uncomfortable analysing employee collaboration metadata, may not need it.

We have not tested Time is Ltd. This page is based on its website and on TechCrunch, Tech.eu and Business Wire.
